name: Loomis Chaffee Summer Program
description_short: A four week boarding and day program at Loomis Chaffee in Windsor for students entering grades 7 to 10. Mornings are two ungraded writing courses and afternoons two electives such as robotics, ceramics or forensic science, with no homework, plus athletics, evening events and weekend trips.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2027 details: June 27 to July 23, 2027, students entering grades 7 to 10. Boarding $9,750 (two writing courses, two electives, room, three meals a day, athletics and activities); day $5,400. Address and phone in the page footer. The page describes it as 'Not summer school. Not summer camp.'
Researched by Claude from this page. FAQ: three meals a day in the dining hall; limited financial aid, priority to current or incoming Loomis Chaffee students, applications due March 1.
